_note: Two meshes: the fuselage, and one lump holding the wing, both nacelles and both proprotors. So the wing has to be a cut. Because the nacelles live on the wingtips, taking the wing off takes the proprotors with it - which is exactly what would happen to the real aircraft.

wing.comment: keeps the ~3.6 m fuselage out of a 25.6 m rotor-tip span
